statements.impact_statement: Limited to docker-buildx v0.38.1-pasturestack.1 in this Dapper filesystem. The unmodified official Buildx source commit 0dbe87f36ed472fe36b6796c3f70b4210a731fc5 (archive SHA256 c5c810b083ed3725f7d4299ba01505b5891d164cf81c3398ea4c3b27a3b71149), built with Go 1.27.3 and exactly x/net v0.60.0/go-archive v0.3.0, compiles only pkg/namesgenerator from the legacy Docker module. The affected daemon containerExtractToDir implementation is absent. Before applying native VEX the gate verifies actual binary identity, resolved compiled packages/files and official namesgenerator hash, native source govulncheck, and that no other binary contains this PURL. Original complete raw findings remain retained; a different source, daemon package or other binary fails qualification. This statement does not apply generally to the Docker module or daemon.
